Fixes #27847
Ruling-ref: 6513306068

## What changes

One file, `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, implementing ruling record 6513306068 (letter B) as worded, and nothing else about the gate:

1. **`evals/**` leaves the PRICED population.** A new population 1b, EVAL FIXTURES (`skills/<name>/evals/**`, decided by path alone through `isEvalFixture()`), takes the generated-file treatment of #12392: measured, printed per file as `(eval fixture)` and in a new `eval fixtures (measured, not ratcheted)` subtotal, counted into the `bundle total (whole shipped tree)`, never ratcheted. The 28 eval rows leave `CEILINGS` with their row comments. A `CEILINGS` row on an eval path is red, exactly as on a generator-owned file, with the ruling named in the refusal.
2. **The standing path.** The header's discipline section and the over-ceiling refusal name the 2026-10-27 ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 as the one gate-recognised raise path for teaching text (`SKILL.md`, `rules/**`, `guides/**`, hand-authored `references/**`): a PR whose diff shows deletion of restatement in the same file and whose body quotes that ruling (or record 6513306068) may move the row by the measured remainder, pinned AT the measurement, with no per-card ruling; a raise with no deletion shown and no ruling quoted stays red. As #23606 B did for the `.claude/**` line ratchet, the script reads neither diffs nor rulings: the conditions are author-facing text that the seat's contract-review record checks against.
3. **Self-test.** 18 new cases, floor 79 → 97: the eval-fixture predicate in both directions (a nested `evals/**` path is one; `SKILL.md`, a rule, a reference, `skills/README.md`, a `rules/evals/` path and a bare `evals/` outside `skills/` are not), an eval fixture with no row is green and says measured-not-ratcheted, a row on one is red naming the ruling, no row names an eval path, the real tree has eval fixtures, the walk still measures them, the report counts them into the bundle total and not into the ratcheted subtotal and prints their subtotal; and the refusal text carries the ruling id, the same-file-deletion condition, the AT-the-measurement pin and the no-deletion-no-ruling red.

Not changed: the walk, the counting convention, the stamp-line exclusion, the generator-owned boundary and its tripwire, every teaching row, `check:skill-eval-tokens` and the eval self-consistency rule. No rule text restates "a raise needs a ruling id per raise" for this gate (`.claude/**`, `skills/README.md`, `AGENTS.md` grepped for the ratchet, `天花板`, `token ceiling`): `triage-duties.md` L102 says a ceiling raise 「仍需明确字句」, which the quoted standing ruling is, so the rule text is untouched.

## Why

The ratchet priced `evals/**`, which no customer session loads (`skills/README.md` layout: evals are 「used by maintainers to score the skill, inert (but harmless) in consumer installs」; `git grep -c "evals/" origin/main -- 'skills/*/SKILL.md'` → 0), so an eval owed under #26369 B blocked on a ceiling that protects nothing a customer pays for, and every measured raise waited on a per-card ruling although the maintainer had already ruled the payment path on 2026-10-27 (quoted 40 times in the row comments). #26940 cost about 20 hours and three seats for +154 tokens. The maintainer ruled B on #27847 (record 6513306068, 「其他同意」).

Confidence gap carried into the dispatch, checked: no harness reads `evals/*.json` into an authoring context. Readers on `origin/main` `9cd54faa`: `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (this gate), `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` (maintainer scoring), `scripts/pm/bare-root-worklist.mjs` (a comment naming the folder), `skills/README.md` (the layout). No SKILL.md, rule, guide or reference points at an eval file.

Serial: PR #27922 (#26940) edits one eval row in this file and still waits on its Tier H approval, so this PR is based on `main`; that row (`skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json`) leaves the priced population in this diff. If #27922 lands first, this branch rebases onto it and the row still leaves.

## Verification

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs --self-test` → `97 cases pass`, exit 0. Ablated once per pin: the predicate forced to `false` → 9 cases red and the gate red on 28 unpriced files; a `CEILINGS` row on `skills/objectui/evals/testing.json` → `no ceiling names an eval fixture` red and the gate red with the eval-fixture refusal; the standing-path text reverted to the old sentence → the 5 standing-path cases red.
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` → exit 0: `56 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings; 10 generator-owned file(s) and 28 eval fixture(s) measured, not ratcheted`. Bundle total 219351 before and after (main's script run on the same tree prints 219351); `ratcheted (authored)` 180861 / 189813, `eval fixtures` 27188.
- `pnpm check:ratchet-remedy-authority` exit 0 (this gate still classified as marking the expanding remedy `⛔ MAINTAINER-ONLY`); `eslint --no-inline-config` on the file clean; `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 32 families on `cc1daeea` (fresh checkout after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts`); every one ran with its exit code captured before any pipe: 32 run, 32 exit 0, 0 NOT MEASURED; `--ran` reconciliation: `32 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 32 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`; re-derived after the commit, still 32. Among them: `check-skills-token-ratchet` and its `--self-test`, `check:ratchet-remedy-authority`, `check:scripts-symbol-anchors`, `check:self-test-wired`, `check:pm-dispatch-gates`, `check:nul-bytes`. No package source changed, so no package test or typecheck is owed; the 11 changeset-dependent families do not apply (`skip-changeset`).
